repair.attempt78_failure_addressed: after three exact active-route fingerprints, the pre-GPU compatibility probe returned invalid Worker version metadata at either RESERVE or urllib PUT; the durable evidence does not distinguish those two substeps
repair.route_response_envelope: route bodies are streamed into at most 4096 bytes and classified only by fixed failure, HTTP status class, expected-version state, content-type class, and body-size-or-shape class
repair.route_redaction_policy: response body, response headers, URL, query, capability material, raw status text, and exception strings are never persisted, logged, or returned
repair.active_route_retry_policy: before the first exact active fingerprint only, preserve the established structured 404 V207_ROUTE_DISABLED fingerprint with a distinct valid predecessor UUID, retry unreachable transport, or retry an exact-version S5XX bounded response diagnostic within the existing 30 reads, 60 seconds, and 2-second sleeps
repair.active_route_nonretry_policy: after the first exact active match every exception or mismatch is terminal; all missing, malformed, wrong-version, S2XX, S3XX, S4XX, and SOTHER response diagnostics outside the established predecessor allowance are immediately terminal
repair.active_route_proof: three consecutive 403 V207_AUTHORITY_REJECTED responses carrying the exact active control-plane version are required before compatibility probing
repair.python_diagnostic_envelope: Python urllib missing, malformed, and wrong Worker versions are classified separately with fixed status classes; the subprocess remains capped at 4096 bytes, rejects stderr, and requires exact exit and status-paired allowlisted Worker codes
repair.probe_stage_diagnostic_envelope: RESERVE, FINALIZE, GET_PORT, and READBACK missing, malformed, and wrong versions carry fixed stage, status, content-type, and declared-length classes; invalid-version response bodies are cancelled; no raw response material is retained
repair.three_cycle_pre_gpu_gate: run three consecutive complete Python urllib PUT, FINALIZE, GET authority, byte readback, and deterministic DELETE cycles before child qualification; each cycle uses a distinct deterministic object and callback identity and records completion only after confirmed cleanup
repair.reserve_retry_policy: RESERVE alone may attempt at most three times with 250 millisecond signal-safe waits only after transport failure or a version-missing S5XX response; every replay uses the exact deterministic nonce, body, and object key and the Worker accepts only an exact sameReservation replay
repair.retry_exclusions: no RESERVE retry for S2XX, S3XX, S4XX, SOTHER, malformed version, wrong version, or unrelated errors; no FINALIZE, GET_PORT, READBACK, upload, GPU, qualification, or redispatch retry

any of the three distinct pre-GPU compatibility cycles fails or its deterministic DELETE is not confirmed before the next cycle
RESERVE exhausts its three exact replay attempts or any non-allowlisted response occurs
the cumulative finite spend could exceed $4.50 or cleanup, reconciliation, output receipt, or settlement becomes uncertain
